name: event-scan
description: Barcode attendance scanner for Amrita Bengaluru events — Cloudflare Worker + D1, served at scan.parswanadh.dev

scripts.db:verify: wrangler d1 execute event-scan-db --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name"
scripts.export:remote: wrangler d1 execute event-scan-db --remote --command "SELECT * FROM scans ORDER BY scanned_at DESC LIMIT 50"
